verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe spawning multiple parallel sub-agents coordinated by a lead agent, running multiple sessions/cloud tasks in parallel, and kicking off long-running or scheduled tasks that can be checked on later or run overnight — directly supporting fleets of parallel, long-running agents. However, no evidence confirms sustained multi-day autonomy in practice, and community reports raise reliability concerns (self-verification failures, degrading output quality over long sessions) that caveat claims of dependable hours/days-long unattended operation.
